name: Congo (People's Republic, 1970–1991)
description: A red field; in the canton a golden five-pointed star above a crossed hammer and hoe within a wreath of palm branches.
history: Flag of the People's Republic of the Congo, Africa's first Marxist-Leninist state; the pan-African green-yellow-red flag returned with multiparty rule in 1991.

features.role: star, crossed hammer and hoe, palm wreath
